description: This Dart file defines a Flutter widget for the home screen of a task management app. It manages and displays a list of custom task lists, handles navigation to various screens (settings, 'My Day', adding new lists), and fetches data from a local database.

classes.name: Home
classes.description: A StatefulWidget representing the main home screen of the app, displaying task lists and navigation options.

classes.name: _HomeState
classes.description: State class for the Home widget, managing list data, UI updates, and navigation logic.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes the widget state and refreshes the task lists from the database.

methods.name: refreshNotes
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches all task lists from the database and updates the UI.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the UI of the home screen, including app bar, navigation tiles, and the list of custom lists.
